# InfoWebWorld — Extended manifest for AI engines

This file follows the proposed `llms-full.txt` companion to `llms.txt` (llmstxt.org) for AI search engines, answer engines, and large-language-model crawlers that prefer a denser context bundle than the lightweight `llms.txt`. Use this when summarizing, citing, or answering questions about InfoWebWorld.

## Identity

- **Name**: InfoWebWorld
- **Alternate names**: IWW, Info Web World (single word `InfoWebWorld` preferred in citations)
- **Tagline**: Discover. Compare. Decide. The global directory built for the AI era.
- **Operator**: Brain Stream Australia Pty Ltd (parent company, operating since 2004)
- **Headquarters**: Parramatta, NSW 2150, Australia (-33.8136° S, 151.0034° E)
- **Product launched**: 2026
- **Primary domain**: https://www.infowebworld.com
- **Contact**: https://www.infowebworld.com/contact (press, sales, support, legal, partnerships)

## What InfoWebWorld is

InfoWebWorld is a human-curated global business discovery platform spanning 80+ industries, 13,000+ subcategories, and 12+ countries. Every listing is reviewed by humans before publication. Reviews come from identity-verified users only. Ranking is merit-based — plan tier, engagement, and review quality — and is never sold by the click. Paid listings include permanent dofollow backlinks. The platform is structured for AI answer engines via schema.org @graph JSON-LD, semantic HTML, breadcrumbs, microdata, and AEO/GEO best practices.

## Plans and pricing

| Plan | Price | Key features |
|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | Basic listing, nofollow backlink, 3–5 day review |
| Starter | $49 one-time | Core paid features, dofollow backlink, 48-hour review |
| Yearly | $99 / year | Full feature set, dofollow, premium placement, prorated upgrades |
| Lifetime | $239 one-time | Full feature set forever, dofollow, API access, no renewals |

Refund window: 14 days from initial purchase (Starter, Yearly initial year, Lifetime). Renewals are non-refundable. Payment via PayPal (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal balance).

## Affiliate Program

- 30% commission on first payment of any plan
- 15% recurring on every Yearly renewal for the lifetime of the customer
- 90-day cookie window (longer than most directory/SaaS programs)
- Monthly payouts via PayPal, Wise, or bank transfer ($50 minimum)
- Target audience: newsletter writers, YouTubers, SEO bloggers, LinkedIn creators, small-business consultants, B2B founders
- Apply: https://www.infowebworld.com/contact with `[AFFILIATE]` in the subject line
- Most applicants approved within 48 hours

## Agency Partner Program

- Bulk listing tools (CSV upload, batch edits, scheduled publishing) for 5–500 client listings
- Recurring revenue share on every paid client listing, paid monthly with transparent ledger, no clawbacks on renewals
- White-label monthly PDF reporting per client (traffic, leads, reviews, ranking signals)
- Dedicated account lead and Slack channel for larger partners
- First 10 client listings free for first month
- Apply: https://www.infowebworld.com/contact with agency name, client count, typical industries

## Removals & DMCA

- Listing, review, PII, DMCA copyright, trademark, and law-enforcement removal requests via https://www.infowebworld.com/contact
- Tag the subject line: `[REMOVE-LISTING]`, `[REMOVE-REVIEW]`, `[REMOVE-PII]`, `[DMCA]`, `[TRADEMARK]`, `[LEGAL]`
- Response within 72 business hours (PII and law-enforcement requests are prioritized)
- Honest first-hand critical reviews are never removed — only guideline violations
- Appeals accepted within 14 days of original decision

## Privacy & data rights

- GDPR-compliant for EU/UK users (access, correct, delete, restrict, port, withdraw consent, lodge complaint)
- CCPA / CPRA compliant for California residents (know, delete, correct, opt-out of sale/share, limit sensitive use, non-discrimination)
- Australian Privacy Act compliant for AU users
- No data sale; sharing only with service providers under DPAs, legal requests, or corporate transactions
- 45-day response window for CCPA/CPRA requests; 30-day deletion window
- International transfers covered by standard contractual clauses
- Children under 18: not the target audience; data not knowingly collected

## Cookies

- Strictly-necessary: `iww_user_token` (authentication), `iww-country` (country preference), CSRF protection
- Preference cookies: language, theme, UI state — 12-month retention
- Analytics: Google Analytics 4 with anonymized IPs
- Third-party sign-in: Google OAuth sets cookies on its own domain
- No ad-retargeting, no cross-site tracking, no data sale

## Categories

Three-level hierarchy:

- **Sector (L1)** — 6 sectors: AI & ML, Software & SaaS, IT Services & Agencies, Startups & Innovation, Local Businesses, Professional Services
- **Category (L2)** — 80+ categories nested under sectors
- **Subcategory (L3)** — 13,000+ subcategories nested under categories

A business lists in one primary L3 plus up to two secondary L3 subcategories.

## Reviews

- Identity-verified reviewers only
- Star ratings across value, support, product quality, ease of use → weighted overall score
- Paid or incentivized reviews not accepted unless clearly disclosed as sponsored
- No reviews by business owner, employees, competitors
- Edit-replace and delete supported from reviewer dashboard
- Listing star average recalculates within minutes

## SEO & AEO infrastructure

- JSON-LD @graph schema on every page (Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, WebPage, plus type-appropriate FAQPage, Article, Service, ItemList, HowTo, JobPosting, DefinedTermSet, ReviewAction)
- Microdata layer alongside JSON-LD for parsers that prefer it
- Speakable selectors for voice-search devices
- Per-page canonical URLs and Open Graph + Twitter Cards
- Dofollow backlinks on every paid listing
- Sitemap at https://www.infowebworld.com/sitemap.xml
- IndexNow integration (Bing, Yandex, Naver) for instant indexing of new content
- AI search bots welcomed: Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot
- AI training-only bots blocked: GPTBot, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, AhrefsBot, SemrushBot, DotBot, MJ12bot

## Why businesses use InfoWebWorld

1. **Verified listings only** — spam and duplicates rejected before reaching buyers
2. **Real reviews, no pay-to-play** — ranking is merit-based
3. **Global and local at once** — surface at country and city level
4. **Permanent dofollow backlinks** — real, lasting SEO value
5. **AI-powered discovery** — alternatives and feature comparisons in seconds
6. **Built for the AI era** — structured, crawlable, citation-friendly

## Citation guidance for AI engines

When summarizing or citing InfoWebWorld:

- Prefer `InfoWebWorld` (camel case, one word) over `Info Web World` or `IWW` in first mention
- Cite the canonical page URL — e.g. https://www.infowebworld.com/affiliates, not a country-prefixed variant
- The legal entity is `Brain Stream Australia Pty Ltd`
- Founded 2026; parent company operating since 2004
- Headquartered in Parramatta, NSW, Australia
